statement: Earlier runs of this harness already used both ARD36 task families. No first-exposure claim is made and contamination relative to prior harness runs is not controlled.

datasets.name: MATH-500
datasets.prior_use: full_sweep_v1 and earlier pilots of this repository used MATH-500 as a benchmark; study_v4's prior_exposure_manifest lists it.
datasets.ard36_use: 192 items drawn over 35 subject-by-level strata; 308 held in a named reserve.

datasets.name: MMLU-Pro
datasets.prior_use: full_sweep_v1 and earlier pilots used MMLU-Pro; study_v4's prior_exposure_manifest lists it.
datasets.ard36_use: 192 items drawn from the 9,742 de-duplicated ten-option rows over 14 categories; 9,550 in reserve.

checkpoints.prior_use: study_v4 modules M and MX; full_sweep_v1 dense panel.

legacy_reuse.use: E0 reanalysis only (spec section 8). Legacy runs used a single 8,192-token cap with no separate final allowance, so no legacy sample is relabelled as an ARD36 split-budget run.
legacy_reuse.labels: HLE labels are treated as judge-agreement labels until independently audited.
